name: vishap
description: Security analysis for engineering materials (code, spec, logs, config).

tools.name: vishap_analyze
tools.description: Analyze code, spec, logs, or config for security risks (SQLi, XSS, RCE, TOCTOU, path traversal, command injection). Returns a structured Markdown report with CWE, STRIDE threat model, and recommendations.

LLM_URL.title: LLM Base URL
LLM_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://api.openai.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

LLM_KEY.title: LLM API Key
LLM_KEY.description: API key for your LLM provider (leave empty for local Ollama / vLLM)

LLM_MODEL.title: LLM Model
LLM_MODEL.description: Model name (e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini, llama3.1, mistral-large-latest)
